symptoms: Large light-brown lesions with concentric rings, up to 1 to 2 cm
Lesions start on mature leaves in the lower canopy and move up
Lesions tear and drop out in the centre, giving a shot-hole look
Rapid defoliation when humid weather persists

severity_cues.early: Few ringed lesions on lower mature leaves
severity_cues.advanced: Defoliation moving up the plant, lesions on bracts and bolls

favorable_conditions: High humidity, warm cloudy weather, closed canopy, late season

treatment.summary: Protective fungicide before wet spells, plus canopy management to slow it
steps: Spray Mancozeb 75 WP at 2.5 g per litre, repeat every 10 days while humid
Balance nitrogen: lush over-fed canopies burn worse
Collect fallen infected leaves and destroy them off the field
Plan pickings: do not delay the first picking in a wet season

products.name: Mancozeb 75 WP
products.label_source: CIB&RC registered label, waiting period on cotton 14 days

organic: Copper oxychloride 50 WP at 2.5 to 3.0 g per litre
Wider spacing next season and balanced fertilization

source.org: ICAR Central Institute for Cotton Research (CICR), cotton disease advisory
source.title: Cotton: target spot management

safety_notes: Wear gloves, mask and full sleeves while spraying
Do not pick cotton within 14 days of spray
